clue.text: Top English physician back in Massachusetts area

clue.text: Firm about narcotic substance

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm

clue.text: Load vehicle before journey

clue.text: Knock back drink around noon and have something to eat

clue.text: Fishing net put straight across small French river

clue.text: Green light seen in space

clue.text: Father has maybe one old possible banger after another
